questions.stem: Which title is best?
questions.explanation: The answer is “Handmade Cards Help Fund a Class Garden”. Evidence: Our class wants new plants for the empty tubs near the gate. We make a decision to sell handmade cards at the school fair. The teacher explains that we can make money by selling our work. First, we ask permission and set a small price for each card. Then we draw simple pictures and write friendly messages inside. At the fair, parents buy several cards and ask about our planting plan. We count what we earned and choose plants that fit our budget.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“Handmade Cards Help Fund a Class Garden”。原文依据：我们班想给门旁空着的花盆添些新植物。我们做出决定，要在学校展会上卖手工卡片。老师解释说，我们可以通过卖作品赚钱。我们先征得许可，再为每张卡片定一个小价格。然后，我们画简单的图，并在里面写上友好的话。展会上，家长买了几张卡片，询问我们的种植计划。我们数清所得，再选择预算之内的植物。

questions.stem: What is the main idea?
questions.explanation: The answer is “A family visit brings informal learning and a chance to save.”. Evidence: My cousin spends a month visiting her grandparents in another town. She can pick up local words by listening to their neighbours talk. She writes the new words in a notebook with examples she hears. Each week, she also helps her grandfather at his small book stall. He gives her a little money, and she puts away some for a future trip. On the last day, she reviews her new words and counts the money she saved. She thanks her grandparents and hopes to return when school holidays begin again.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“A family visit brings informal learning and a chance to save.”。原文依据：我表姐在另一个镇的祖父母家住了一个月。她听邻居们交谈，就能学会一些当地的词。她把新词和听到的例句写在笔记本里。每周，她还在爷爷的小书摊帮忙。爷爷给她一点钱，她存起一部分，为将来的旅行准备。最后一天，她复习新学的词，并数清自己攒下的钱。她感谢祖父母，希望下次学校放假时再来。
